query: Bacche ko dast aur ulti hai, primary health centre par kya upchar diya jana chahiye?
reference_answer: Bachon me acute watery diarrhea ke liye Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) aur 14 din tak Zinc supplementation (10-20 mg/day) dena chahiye. Dehydration ke lakshan jaise aankhein dhasna ya behoshi hone par turant doctor ko refer karein.

query: Universal Immunization Programme ke antargat janam ke samay kaun se teeke lagte hain?
reference_answer: Janam ke samay 3 mukhya teeke diye jate hain: BCG (tuberculosis se bachav), OPV birth dose (polio), aur Hepatitis B birth dose (pehli 24 ghante ke andar).

query: Garbhavastha me kitni ANC jaanch aur IFA goliya di jani chahiye?
reference_answer: Pratyek garbhwati mahila ko kam se kam 4 Antenatal Care (ANC) checkup karwane chahiye. Saath hi kam se kam 180 Iron Folic Acid (IFA) goliya aur 360 Calcium goliya di jani chahiye.

query: Kala-Azar ke mukhya lakshan kya hain aur iski pushti ke liye kaun sa test hota hai?
reference_answer: 15 din se adhik ka bukhar jo antibiotics par theek na ho, spleen (pleeha) ka badhna aur anemia Kala-Azar ke mukhya lakshan hain. PHC star par iski pushti rK-39 Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) kit se hoti hai.

query: PHC supervisor ke roop me low attendance workers ko kaise track kiya jata hai?
reference_answer: ASHA aur ANM workers ki haziri daily monitor ki jati hai. Pichhle 30 dinon me 75% se kam attendance wale workers ko low-attendance flag kiya jata hai aur unhe follow-up ya counselling ke liye contact kiya jata hai.
